notes.manas-2010:p0916:b001:l001: Аманат жан is life entrusted to a mortal, with religious overtones; not a hostage here.
notes.manas-2010:p0916:b001:l016: Five holy elders are grammatically equated with Shai Ata in the following row. Preserved this visionary identity without silently reducing the number to one or five companions.
notes.manas-2010:p0916:b001:l023: Honor being covered is provisionally rendered secured/protected; not a claim of shameful concealment.
notes.manas-2010:p0916:b001:l031: чинар тал may designate plane trees collectively; plane trees and willows retains both visible tree words. Botanical grouping uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0916:b001:l037: Printed Кожой кызыр read as Khoja Khizir invocation, not the unrelated verb кожой- (stiffen). Exact invocation attested in a recorded blessing: https://www.azattyk.org/amp/kyrgyz_culture_folklore_ichkilik_group_love_songs_pt1_2017/28947617.html. Honorific interpretation provisional; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0916:b001:l038: Repeated ancestral khans and Khizir favor kept across all four rows; no genealogical names supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l004: Literal eye of the leopard retained as heroic metaphor; precise idiomatic force may be embodiment/essence, not an anatomical event.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l006: Seven saints kept although previous page names five holy elders. No numerical harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l009: айран here expresses astonishment, not fermented milk. The grammatical subject of astonishment is implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l012: Alternating thousand men/one man retained as visionary appearance; not literal troop count.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l015: сыр as hidden powers/capabilities in this heroic description. Exact idiomatic force of далайга салар qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l030: Khojosan is a protecting saint/spirit in Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/КОЖОСАН/; proper patron name retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l031: сура- can mean ask or rule (Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/сура/). Accusative төрөнү and subject менде favor mortals asking of/about the prince; not silently rewritten to prince ruling all mortals. Clause linkage provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l036: Аргын кандын Ажыбай literally Ajybai of the Argyn khan; precise patronymic/title relation left open.
notes.manas-2010:p0917:b001:l038: салбырын is a group hunting expedition; argali and wild asses retained next row.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l003: Медийен retained as the epic desert designation, with no identification as modern Medina. A descriptive unpeopled wilderness reading also occurs in working drafts; requires lexical collation.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l005: Кайыпчы retained as the name attached to a shrine; relation to preceding Kayyp-Mazar and Kara-Kyr is not expanded into an invented itinerary.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l007: керүү is a grassy upper mountain slope; Жаңгактуу retained as source place designation, literally walnut-bearing. Case construction irregular; spatial linkage qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l013: Printed салышьш is an apparent ы/ь glyph error in the repeated washing construction; understood as салышып. Raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l017: Амаз understood as намаз with lost initial н, consistent with edition introduction discussion of initial consonant loss and explicit ablutions/call to prayer.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l021: кайып marks miraculous/unseen appearance; no naturalistic explanation added.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l027: кыраан encompasses exceptional beings in this inventory of animal and human companions; finest creatures chosen without limiting to human warriors.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l034: башка ачылып rendered blossomed anew; alternative fortune opening upon his head remains possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l039: Edition glossary1841:l011 Мураапы - мурасчы, жөлөк-таяк resolves support/mainstay here for carrying loads; not irrigation official. https://el-sozduk.kg/МУРАП/ gives related мурапы support/legacy senses.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l040: каймана indicates arrival from outside/afar, not established kinship here.
notes.manas-2010:p0918:b001:l042: Chubak likened to an entire host when driven forward; battle supplied from heroic military context, not an added event.
